stories.title: Eleanor Donaldson given supervision order and placed on sex offenders' register
stories.summary: Eleanor Donaldson was found to have done the acts in relation to five charges, including four of aiding and abetting his offending, in a 'trial of the facts'.

stories.title: Global Microsoft outage affecting NI schools, councils and other services
stories.summary: The outage started on Thursday, with monitoring website Downdetector seeing problems reported in more than 70 countries.

stories.title: Laughter and learning at BBC Children in Need-backed homework club
stories.summary: Ledley Hall Boys and Girls Club is one of the many projects in NI supported by BBC Children in Need.

stories.title: My physical deformity left me feeling invisible - but one surgeon saw me
stories.summary: Charlie Clarke says the physical and emotional effects of pectus excavatum have been "unimaginable".

stories.title: Police officers sacked for 'despicable' on-duty filming of vulnerable people
stories.summary: The behaviour of the two male officers is branded "utterly despicable" by the police ombudsman.

stories.title: Success for BBC at Royal Television Society NI awards
stories.summary: The BBC has won ten awards at the Royal Television Society NI Awards in Belfast on Thursday night.

stories.title: Cost of Noah Donohoe inquest to public purse revealed
stories.summary: An inquest into the schoolboy's death faced numerous delays and overran initial estimates for its duration by several months.

stories.title: Plans to increase Windsor Park capacity to 23,750
stories.summary: The planned redevelopment of Windsor Park to enable the stadium to host games at the 2035 Women's World Cup includes proposals to increase the capacity of the stadium to 23,750, according to a Fifa report.

stories.title: Former president of Athletics NI pleads guilty to child sex abuse charge
stories.summary: A former president of Athletics Northern Ireland has been put on the sex offenders register after pleading guilty to a child sex offence.

stories.title: Former senior police officer believes agent involved in Omagh bomb
stories.summary: Retired Ch Supt Norman Baxter was the Senior Investigating Officer (SIO) of the Omagh Bombing investigation from May 2002 until he retired in November 2008.

stories.title: Europe's security 'fundamentally reshaped' by war in Ukraine
stories.summary: Europe's security has been "fundamentally reshaped" by Russia's war in Ukraine, the taoiseach has said.

stories.title: Body 'kept in van for two weeks' before being moved to lough
stories.summary: Kenneth Lynch, 31, from Trasna Park in Enniskillen, was remanded in custody after appearing at Strabane Magistrates' Court via videolink.
